hero_subtitle: Explore how West Northamptonshire Council manages public money. Budget analysis powered by GOV.UK MHCLG data.
publisher_bio: This website was created by Tom Pickup, Reform UK county councillor for Padiham and Burnley West and Cabinet Member for Adult Social Care at Lancashire County Council. He is also parish councillor for Clowbridge with Dunnockshaw. Tom builds transparency tools that make public spending data easier to check.
publisher_titles: County Councillor for Padiham and Burnley West
Cabinet Member for Adult Social Care, Lancashire County Council
Parish Councillor for Clowbridge with Dunnockshaw
publisher_quote: It's your money. The more people understand where it goes, the better.

spend_triangulation.note: Transparency gross = £4.21B across every class in the published corpus. Procurement-paid (discretionary third-party payments) = £4.11B. Non-procurement rows: Care-Act redacted direct payments to individuals (£100.2M) — all excluded from third-party-supplier forensic analyses. Net revenue budget figures (where published) are smaller again because they net capital, grants received, and reserves movements — transparency totals include all of these.

procurement_paid.note: Discretionary third-party supplier payments — the real procurement footprint.

direct_payment_individual.note: Care Act 2014 + UK GDPR redactions — foster carers, SGO recipients, ASC service-user direct-payment holders. Lawfully unnamed.

political_control.tenure_note: Reform UK majority since the 1 May 2025 all-out election (42 of 76; 40 by June 2026 after defections, a bare majority on a 39 threshold). Leader Cllr Mark Arnull (Reform) since 15 May 2025, confirmed through the 18 May 2026 cabinet reshuffle. A 2021-created unitary inheriting the former Northamptonshire CC legacy. Same may_2025 cohort as North Northants and the counties (previously mis-tagged may_2026_new).
